events.title: Demo out now!
events.summary: Demo out now!The demo for 10 Million Pixels is officially out! This demo features a smaller world of 50,000 pixels, 6 different balls with unique abilities, and an amazing soundtrack by Pulsewith, in the search of the Golden Pixel.Download the demo now or check out this new trailer first.// BATTLE LAB

events.title: Music Announcement!
events.summary: Music by Pulsewith (Justin Skomarovsky)I'm happy to announce that 10 Million Pixels is getting amazing music by the talented Pulsewith, also know as Justin Skomarovsky. He previously made the soundtrack for The Loopler and has worked on other projects such as Call of Duty.Wanna listen to a sneak peak? Check out this teaser for the new music!Stay tuned for the demo dropping next week!// BATTLE LAB

events.title: Thank you!
events.summary: The reception since the announcement has been crazy! We just went from 1,000 to 50,000 wishlists in just 4 days!I just want to thank everybody who wishlisted the game as we just hit this milestone! Thank you!A special thank you to Indie Game Joe! Him sharing the game was the spark that caused all this momentum!Demo coming soon! // BATTLE LAB
